edition.check: Level 5: barcode matches exactly in Discogs (33691152), but no second source carries this barcode (MusicBrainz and iTunes cover the 2024 CD/digital editions, and the shop photo's barcode was unreadable), so NOT MET. Level 4: barcode match in only one source, and the other 2024 LP/picture-disc editions (31907761, 31972811, 31918495) carry different barcodes and catnos, so the input barcode singles this edition out. MET. Rating 4.
edition.summary: The input EAN matches only the Discogs RSD 2025 release (33691152), with a valid check digit and consistent catno, title and artist, but no second source confirms that barcode.

tracklist.check: Level 5: NOT MET, the shop photo OCR disagrees on C3 title (KLINGEN vs Fliegen) and on durations, so it is not two sources agreeing on everything. Level 4: MET. Discogs is a complete 16-track source for this vinyl edition, and the shop photo confirms count, order and 15 of 16 titles, with the deviations explained as OCR errors; durations come from another edition (MusicBrainz CD) that agrees with Discogs within 1 s.
tracklist.summary: Discogs gives a complete 16-track side list that the RSD shop photo confirms in count, order and titles apart from explained OCR misreads (C3 title, B3/C3/D3 durations).

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 0% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 0% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: Database + independent primary source of the same edition. Discogs is a database and the RSD shop photo is a manufacturer/shop product image of the back cover, but its content was read only via OCR and the barcode is unreadable, so the primary-source condition is only partly met. Level 4: MET. Two database entries (Discogs and MusicBrainz/iTunes) plus a shop product photo; MusicBrainz and iTunes describe a different carrier, though, so only Discogs covers this exact edition.
sources.summary: The RSD edition rests on the Discogs database entry plus an OCR-read official shop photo, while MusicBrainz and iTunes cover other editions of the same album.

concerns: Validator warns of high confidence 0.92 despite 7 open conflicts; the conflicts are resolved by reasoning (capitalisation, OCR), but the barcode match rests only on Discogs.
The C3 title on the shop photo reads KLINGEN, which the agent attributes to OCR error; the explanation is plausible but unverified on the carrier.
Durations for the vinyl edition itself were not measured; ms-precise durations come from the 2024 CD (MusicBrainz) and digital (iTunes) editions, which the result discloses.

Guest credits (MIA., Hansi Biebl Band, jan SEVEN dettwyler, Kadavar) come from CD/digital recording credits and are not printed on the vinyl; the result's artist credits for A2, B1, D1–D4 are therefore unverified for this edition.
Back-cover images on Discogs returned HTTP 403, so the carrier print was not read directly; the barcode on the shop photo was unreadable.
The 2024 black-vinyl 2LP (31907761) shares catno 2984265RMP; the agent did not check whether its tracklist differs, though its different barcode excludes it for this input.
Discogs 'Long Player' C3 duration 4:35 vs MusicBrainz 4:36 and D3 4:12 are consistent, but Discogs B3 2:34 vs OCR 3:31 is a large gap that the agent attributes to OCR without carrier confirmation.

validation_warnings: high confidence despite open conflicts – justify or lower it
